descFull: Download anything on Android: a free, open-source torrent client, download manager, video downloader and subtitle downloader in one app. Pause and resume links, save HLS/m3u8 streams, auto-fetch subtitles for movies and series, search 40+ torrent sources, auto-download RSS. Ad-free browser, no account. Alternative to 1DM, ADM, LibreTorrent, Flud
